gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai: Bruno Ace draws every line like it was run along a ruler, its curves staying wide open to the outside. IBM Plex Sans Thai feels modern beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-thai-l: IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped is a clean sans whose curves refuse to close, leaving each letter gently ajar. And Bruno Ace above it keeps a lingering, one-character-per-beat pace that makes the whole line feel unhurried.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-imprima: Imprima reads smooth and approachable, each line like a soft tube with terminals that flare outward. But if Bruno Ace were shrunk down, its ruler-straight, lingering letters would lose the room they need.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-inclusive-sans: Expressive is the first word for Bruno Ace, whose open counters and ruler-straight lines give each letter its own beat. Inclusive Sans follows over a long stretch with round letters whose rims match their stems, so the curves feel open-ended and professional.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-inria-sans: Inria Sans has tubular strokes like bent copper pipe and openings you can see straight through, giving it a modern, contemporary look. Bruno Ace is the showpiece; Inria Sans does the quiet work.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-istok-web: Bruno Ace sets its heading in straight-edged, constant strokes with a lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm that feels distinctive. Istok Web is the one for approachable reading, its rounded sans-serif letters leaving a clearly open side.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-jost: Distinctive is the right word for Bruno Ace, with counters that stay connected to the outside and a ruler-drawn line. Jost earns its place with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, while the heading does its best work big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-jura: Jura reads neutral and clean, its strokes as constant as bent wire and its s curves opening wide at both ends. Bruno Ace earns its keep when it is big and short.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-k2d: K2D holds a tube-like thickness through every bend, with c terminals that hang far from the bowl, so lines feel clean and neutral. Bruno Ace adds the expressive, ruler-drawn headline.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kanchenjunga: A ruler-drawn, constant-width line gives Bruno Ace its most distinctive look, with counters left connected to the outside. Kanchenjunga takes over where the heading shows off, offering the steady line of a technical drafting pen that never clogs at low resolution.
